label: Finite controls for Darwinian epistemic debunking and its self-application
paraphrase: Five finite controls. Origin fixing with within-history variation gives a tracking failure while the actual verdict is accurate. Variation without origin fixing leaves every history-mate accurate. History-fixed correctness with an accurate selection-fixed verdict has no tracking failure. In the existing targeted reliability control the realist self-application premises hold and the conclusion lacks warrant while true, with thin F6 holding as undefeated support for other content. With history-fixed correctness for every basis, the uniform policy, sole-basis and warrant conditions hold and the conclusion is warranted.
